{{Quotation|game|This fortress was designed by the famed [[Kurzick]] architect [[Lord Stein zu Heltzer]] more than five hundred years ago. One of the few remaining structures of true stone (which therefore dates from the time before the [[Jade Wind]]), Fort Aspenwood has long stood at a key strategic location along the [[Kurzick-Luxon border|Kurzick/Luxon border]]. The Kurzicks have managed to hold the fort against [[Luxon]] encroachment for centuries...but this arrangement may not last forever.}}

[[Fort Aspenwood (Kurzick)|Fort Aspenwood]] is one of the two mission outposts where players can enter the [[Fort Aspenwood]] competitive mission. Players enter alone and are randomly teamed up on the Kurzick side.

==Getting there==
[[PvP-only character]]s will be [[teleport]]ed here by the [[Kurzick Recruiter]] in the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]].

[[Roleplaying character]]s can enter this outpost from [[Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick)]]. The quest [[Defend Fort Aspenwood]] leads the player here, but is not required to enter. Once the outpost has been unlocked on the map, roleplaying characters can use the Kurzick Recruiter as well.
